newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine gas firm in pact with Petron.
newsitem.headline: Philippine gas firm in pact with Petron.

text.p: A subsidiary of Philippine property firm Pryce Properties Corp said on Tuesday it had signed a five-year agreement for the purchase of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) with Petron Corp.
Pryce Gases Inc will start to market LPG in the central and southern Philippines next month, its president Salvador Escano told Reuters.
Pryce will invest 200 million pesos to build three LPG refilling stations with total storage capacity of 360,000 tonnes.
Escano said the company expects to generate 300 million pesos in consumer gas sales after two years.
